title: Finite smooth purity source tensor composition
statement: For the fixed coefficient-line comparisons and ordinary pullback cocycle, the puritySource functors and pullbackTwistComparison maps satisfy the unrestricted QuotientCocycle square.

proof.text: Expand puritySource and pullbackTwistComparison. The tensor coefficient-composition square follows by tensor associativity, naturality of scalar extension, and the supplied coefficient comparison htwist; combine it with the ordinary pullback cocycle hpull and functoriality of the derived tensor bifunctor to obtain the displayed QuotientCocycle for every input.
